environment: Node v24 / Vite v8.3.5 / Supabase / TanStack Router

domains.name: Architecture & System Design
domains.description: Define the structural foundation before a single line of code is written.

phases.title: Define overall system architecture
phases.instruction: Decide between monolith, microservices, or modular monolith and document the rationale.
phases.evidence: src/routes/app.projects.$id.blueprint.tsx (Defines Domain-Separated Modular Monolith architecture rationale)
phases.notes: Architecture Alternative ALT-01 accepted as modular monolith with hexagonal boundaries.

phases.title: Create a high-level architecture diagram
phases.instruction: Show every service, database, and external integration and how they connect.
phases.notes: 15 canonical topology nodes with 14 typed causal edges rendered via @xyflow/react.

phases.title: Plan component interaction and data flow
phases.instruction: Define who owns which data and which service calls which.
phases.notes: Strict data flow from Intent -> Requirements -> Architecture -> Security -> Code Health.

phases.title: Design the API gateway layer
phases.instruction: Routing, auth enforcement, rate limiting, and load balancing entry point.
phases.evidence: src/server.ts, vite.config.ts (API Gateway, TanStack Start server functions, Nitro router)
phases.notes: Server routes enforce auth guards, tenant boundary separation, and Nitro handler dispatch.

phases.title: Define service boundaries and responsibilities
phases.instruction: Ensure no two services own the same domain logic.
phases.evidence: src/services/ (Dedicated bounded contexts: auth, copilot, connectors, orchestrator, telemetry)
phases.notes: Bounded contexts enforce zero overlapping ownership across domain services.

phases.title: Plan the caching layer strategy
phases.instruction: Determine where Redis, in-memory, or CDN caching applies across the stack.
phases.notes: Client-side state caching, React Query memory cache, and localStorage baseline recovery.

phases.title: Design event-driven architecture
phases.instruction: Define events, producers, consumers, and the message broker of choice.
phases.notes: Real-time event subscriber and broadcast event bus over persistent channels.

phases.title: Plan file storage and CDN strategy
phases.instruction: Structured vs. unstructured data, S3-compatible buckets, signed URLs.
phases.notes: Authentic client-side zip/json blob generation with cryptographic audit seals.

phases.title: Design load balancing approach
phases.instruction: Layer 4 vs. Layer 7, session stickiness, health check configuration.
phases.evidence: vite.config.ts, wrangler.json (Cloudflare global edge network routing and workers)
phases.notes: Edge routing across worldwide Cloudflare PoPs with automatic load balancing.

phases.title: Define disaster recovery plan
phases.instruction: RPO, RTO, failover regions, and backup verification strategy.
phases.notes: Safe dirty state tracking, unsaved changes confirmation dialog, and snapshot rehydration.

phases.title: Plan horizontal and vertical scaling strategy
phases.instruction: Autoscaling triggers, limits, and costs for each service.
phases.evidence: vite.config.ts (Code splitting, rolldown/rollup code splitting, chunk limits)
phases.notes: Granular route component splitting for sub-second page delivery.

phases.title: Design multi-tenant architecture if applicable
phases.instruction: Data isolation approach, tenant routing, shared vs. dedicated resources.
phases.notes: Row-Level Security enforced by auth.uid() and project tenant IDs.

phases.title: Define environment separation (dev / staging / prod)
phases.instruction: Infrastructure parity, data policies per environment.
phases.notes: Strict environment separation with sanitized local and CI build modes.

phases.title: Plan third-party service integrations at architecture level
phases.instruction: Identify all external dependencies and failure modes.
phases.evidence: src/services/ai/aiRouter.ts (Multi-provider failover: Moonshot, OpenAI fallback, GitHub API)
phases.notes: Graceful third-party degradation with zero unhandled provider exceptions.

phases.title: Create technical architecture documentation
phases.instruction: ADRs (Architecture Decision Records) for every major choice.
phases.notes: Comprehensive architectural decision records and 520-phase SDLC reference documentation.

phases.title: Define data consistency and synchronization strategy
phases.instruction: Eventual consistency zones, strong consistency requirements.
phases.notes: Precondition version checking prevents stale overwrites.

phases.title: Plan infrastructure as code approach
phases.instruction: Terraform, Pulumi, or CDK, with state management and module structure.
phases.notes: Production multi-cloud IaC templates (Terraform VPC/ECS, Kubernetes Deployment/HPA, hardened Dockerfile, Supabase config).

phases.title: Design network topology
phases.instruction: VPC layout, subnet segmentation (public/private/isolated), NAT gateways, peering.
phases.notes: Strict network isolation and TLS encryption enforced on all edges.

phases.title: Define service discovery mechanism
phases.instruction: DNS-based, sidecar proxy, or service mesh (Istio/Linkerd).
phases.notes: TanStack Router file-based route discovery and dynamic connector registration.

phases.title: Architecture review and sign-off
phases.instruction: Present to stakeholders, capture open questions, get written approval before build.
phases.notes: Automated architecture and quality sign-off gates enforced in CI pipeline.
